Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shield Sphere, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1976-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.

1887-2021-2060-4565.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

465-3742-4251-5434-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4188-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 7 life this turn.
4188-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-3446.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Herald of Kozilek.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Herald of Kozilek.
Repeat.

2292-2730-5987.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

539-1887-3488-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus by tapping them, adding {3}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.

Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-6740-6823.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Aunt May triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-4871-5921-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodbond Vampire by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Bloodbond Vampire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1084-1491-2757-6667.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.

Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Loporrit Scout ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least six +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Activate Workhorse six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3525-3755-6210.notablePrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3755-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

751-1741-3147-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional land that can tap to produce {U}
751-1741-3147-5914.notes:
If you control a second land that produces two or more mana, this also produces infinite mana.

If you have a creature with mana value 0 that can survive after being cast for 0 mana, you can bounce it each time in step 9 and also cast it infinite times.

Paradise Mantle attached to Leech Bonder.

Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.

Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from one creature to another creature.

618-3617-3662-4836.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
618-3617-3662-4836.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, but you cannot sacrifice the Izzet Chemister token due to The Master.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-3602-4050-5296.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and goading it.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

512-4050-5089.notablePrerequisites: Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.
512-4050-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Halo Fountain to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.

907-1479-2907.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-2907.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

262-671-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-671-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Daxos three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

1671-4222-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.
1671-4222-4644.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
